question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage** indicates the end of the breakfast meal.**
 
• **"Over" **is commonly used to signify** the conclusion of an activity, which fits this context perfectly.**
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is '**over**'.

Complete Passage: *At the breakfast table the next morning, there was no sign of my wife. I concluded she was sleeping late, but Gladolia, upon being questioned, only shook her head, muttered something, and turned the whites of her eyes up to the ceiling. I was glad when the meal was **over**__ and hurried to the library for another try at that story.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

"Removed," "through," and "undone" do not fit logically, as they imply different actions or states that are not related to the completion of a meal.

 
• **Removed** (हटाया हुआ): "Removed" means taken away or off from the position occupied, which is not appropriate here.
 
• **Through** (पार): "Through" means moving in one side and out of the other side of an opening, channel, or location, which does not fit the context of describing the end of a meal.
 
• **Undone** (खोला गया): "Undone" means unfastened or unwrapped, which does not relate to completing a meal.
